messages:
marco-ml: Hey folks — planning a ~10 week writing sabbatical in Hawaii (Aug 1 → Oct 9). Quick Qs: do I need to change my home base? Will the WFH stipend be pro-rated/paused while I’m away? Any payroll/tax or benefits gotchas? Also want to ship my work laptop there.

michael-peopleops: Hey Marco — short answers: temporary stays under ~90 days usually don’t trigger a home-base change. WFH stipend is monthly and prorated on start/end; for short temporary stays we typically keep it unless you request otherwise. Laptop shipping OK — open an ops ticket and tag us so we can coordinate asset transfer + shipping policy. :thumbsup:

alex-payroll: Marco — please confirm your current legal homebase (state) and the full HI mailing address. If you keep OR as homebase, withholding stays as-is. If you formally change declared homebase we need at least 2 weeks lead to update state withholding forms and run a final payroll reconciliation.

jules-legal: Quick legal note: a single employee’s 10-week temporary work location is unlikely to create corporate tax nexus, but repeated or concurrent remote employees in the same jurisdiction could. Don’t do any client-facing on-island gigs without notifying us. If you plan to take contractors there or hire temp help, loop legal.

marco-ml: Thanks. I’ll keep OR as my legal homebase. Not client-facing. If it helps: I’ll be on vacation-heavy schedule some weeks but still working ~30 hrs/wk.

michael-peopleops: Sounds fine — please fill out the temporary-remote form (https://go/redwood-temp-remote) with dates, mailing address, and emergency contact. Mark it as "short-term remote". We’ll flag payroll to monitor days out-of-state. Also note healthcare network: Hawaii may be out-of-network for some providers.

payroll-bot: Payroll reminder: employees physically present in another US state for more than 30 days in a rolling 12-month period may require withholding and unemployment updates. HR will track aggregate days and notify payroll ops if thresholds are hit.

sara-benefits: Heads-up — if you need medical care while there, check in-network vs out-of-network coverage. For out-of-network visits, keep receipts for reimbursement requests. If you’re on a dependent-care FSA, check eligibility for care while traveling.

marco-ml: Got it — I’ll submit the form today and open an ops ticket for laptop shipping. Any tips for keeping coverage while I’m there?

michael-peopleops: Tag @michael-peopleops on the form and in the ops ticket. We’ll confirm benefits implications and approve the laptop transfer. Enjoy the sabbatical! :palm_tree:
